method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Wendy 给 Hattie 开门，Hattie 观察到对方眼下发黑、头发凌乱，明显睡眠不足，Wendy 强笑把她让进屋。
facts.anchor: When Wendy opens the front door, Hattie guesses the other woman got about as much sleep as she did the night before.

facts.fact: Kevin 为前一晚的事向 Mary（Hattie）道歉，承认本该倾听，说她当时是在帮忙而且说得对。
facts.anchor: I should have listened. You were trying to help, and more importantly, you were right.

facts.fact: Wendy 说 Julian 被无限期停学，Bastion 也因有欺凌前科同样被停学。
facts.anchor: Julian’s suspended until further notice,” Wendy says. “And so is Bastion, given the history of bullying.

facts.fact: Kevin 说法庭上剪刀会被认定为致命武器，因此此事可能变严重。
facts.anchor: But the scissors will be considered a deadly weapon.

facts.fact: Kevin 说他们已约好当天下午与一名与法院密切合作的儿童心理学家见面。
facts.anchor: We’ve got an appointment this afternoon with a child psychologist who works closely with the court.

facts.fact: Kevin 透露 Julian 把那把剪刀带了将近一周，每天放学都藏在课桌里，虽从未伤害过人却已准备伤害那个孩子。
facts.anchor: He was carrying those scissors around for almost a week—hid them in his desk at the end of each day.

facts.fact: Julian 出现在阁楼栏杆边低头看着众人，表情茫然；Hattie 不知他醒了多久。
facts.anchor: Julian stands at the loft’s railing, looking down at them, his expression blank.

facts.fact: Wendy 说他们十五分钟后要与律师通话，请 Hattie 把 Jules 带出去待一会儿，Hattie 出于被信任的暖意答应了。
facts.anchor: We have a call with our attorney in fifteen minutes. Do you think you could take Jules outside for a while?
